2.

This appeal has been filed for grant of bail to the appellant after setting aside the order dated 01.12.2023 passed in connection with SC/ST Bhabua P.S. Case 11 of 2023 whereby and whereunder cognizance has been taken under Sections 341, 323, 504, 506, 376, 419, 420 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 3(i)(r)(s)/(w) 3(2)(v) of the SC/ST Act and prayer for bail of the appellant has been rejected by learned Special Court, Schedule Caste and Scheduled Tribe (prevention of Atrocities) Act, District Kaimur at Bhabua.

APP (SJ)
No.159 of 2024(2) dt.16-02-2024 506, 376, 419, 420 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 3(i)(r)(s)/(w) 3(2)(v) of the SC/ST Act against five named persons.

Learned counsel for the informant appeared in the Court and petitioner live together and all matters are settled between them, compromise petition already filed before the trial Court and certified copy of that compromise petition annexed with this case.

Learned counsel for the first wife Soni Kumari objected at extent to this contention and this averment in compromise petition dated 04.11.2023 for Soni Kumari is first wife and she has entitled all right of benefit of legal wedded wife.
Victim has no right as a wife and averments made in compromise petition is not acceptable as per law.
